title: The No-Think Peach Snack With 42g Protein
description: This easy sweet-and-savory snack pairs a BUILT Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff, Peachy Ring clear protein, and a hard-boiled egg for approximately 42 grams of protein and 320 calories.
image_prompt: A realistic high-protein snack styled in a bright, clean home kitchen. Show one unopened BUILT Sweet Peach Punch Sour Puff still fully inside its original wrapper, placed flat on a small neutral ceramic plate. Place one peeled whole hard-boiled egg beside the wrapped bar on the plate. Beside the plate, show a clear drinking glass filled with translucent peach-orange clear protein drink and ice. In the background, show a standing pink and coral Clean Simple Eats Peachy Ring Clear Protein Powder bag, softly out of focus but recognizable as a protein powder package. Natural window lighting, simple everyday presentation, appetizing and uncluttered. Keep the protein puff completely inside the wrapper. Do not open, cut, unwrap, or alter the bar. Do not show shredded food, saucy food, mixed food, fruit, garnishes, crumbs, extra ingredients, or a messy plate.
